This file is the contract between two independent implementations of
config.getAgent. Each side asserts against it, so a rename, a spelling
change, a revision-format change or a different empty-value convention
fails a test on BOTH sides instead of only surfacing at runtime on a
That is not hypothetical: an earlier revision of this feature shipped with
the Gateway accepting only the config-array shape while the other side sent
an already-projected menu. The projection returned null, no menu reached the
tool description, the model_tier parameter never appeared, and tiering was
silently absent — with every test in both repositories green, because each
one fed itself the shape it produced.

projectedMenu.$comment: Preferred shape: the producer projects, so provider/modelId never reach the menu channel. snake_case matches every other field on that RPC.

items.when_to_use: read logs, grep code, check config — retrieval and summary
cross-source causal reasoning, or a conclusion a human reads

configArray.$comment: Legacy/Standalone shape: raw config, camelCase, provider and modelId present. Still accepted; the Gateway projects and hashes it locally.

value.whenToUse: read logs, grep code, check config

candidates.$comment: The credential-bearing half, carried on the model binding. Must share a revision with the menu describing the same configuration. modelConfig is abridged here; only its presence is contractual.

rules.$comment: Assertions both sides must satisfy. Stated as data so neither side can quietly relax one.
